title: WU JEN SEVENTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 12 seventh level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R676 OA wu jen seventh level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty-three (capture pp. 203-207): the wu jen seventh level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN SEVENTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 203-207 - the OA wu jen seventh level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 203-207; compressed pp. 93-95); all 12 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the print Components apostrophe-s V typo on the vanish block reading V in both passes, and body outside body the OA printing its near-duplicate of the sixth level vessel at the seventh (the same duplicate-creating spell at both levels). The level carries THREE dual-school prints again, all pinned primary (the exaction precedent): elemental servant the Conjuration/Summoning; Enchantment/Charm dual pinned 4, ice blight the Evocation/Summoning dual pinned 3, obedience the Enchantment/Evocation dual pinned 1. Conjuration the most common school at five spells; alteration and evocation two each; commune with greater spirit the lone divination, reanimation the lone necromantic, obedience the lone enchantment/charm; NO illusion, invocation or abjuration spell this level. The component census: seven VSM, FOUR verbal-only spells (limited wish, power word stun, tool, vanish) - the most verbal-only of any wu jen level yet - and withering palm the lone verbal and somatic; no V,M spell this level. Limited wish carries BOTH the Casting Time: Special line (pinned -1, the R662 exorcise convention) and the special save; three one-turn casts (commune with greater spirit, elemental servant, ice blight), three single segments (body outside body, power word stun, tool), obedience and reanimation the one-round casts, duo-dimension seven, vanish two, withering palm four segments. Two negation saves (elemental servant, obedience), two special (limited wish, reanimation), withering palm the lone half save. One reversible spell (ice blight, drought). The element column cross-checks the R669 dieWJT66L7Element grid: the ONE tagged cell (ice blight Water) matching the landed pin exactly
